description.html: This is a 250 liter terrarium with a 100x50 cm floor and a 3D background along the entire back wall. We carve the background by hand from styrofoam in the shape of rock, and at half a meter of depth it does not take away space the animal needs. The height is also 50 cm.

Half a square meter of floor is enough for an adult bearded dragon, with a comfortable margin over the 100x40 cm minimum. The dragon uses the ledges of the background as steps toward the warmer air under the lamp. An adult corn snake gets both the length and the height for the odd branch, and a ball python gets a wide floor for large hides.

We agree the shape of the background, rock or bark, before the build, as well as the pattern of the film on the outer sides. We list the same terrarium without a background as model 100x50x50. Because of its size, place it on a floor cabinet, and a build with your changes takes 7 to 14 days. We ship it by courier within Serbia, with the background installed.
